scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent omitted required opening branding at turn 1 ('S-Net broadband diagnostics, Kieran speaking...'), completely failing to say 'Thank you for calling S-Net'.

scorecard.name: Hold time and Dead Air
scorecard.coaching: Agent breached dead air standards twice with unannounced silent pauses of 35s and 38s while testing optical lines and checking scheduling, prompting caller chasing on both occasions.

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely skipped account security verification, failing to request installation address, security PIN, or security questions during the first 240 seconds or at any point in the call.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to personalize the call, never addressing the caller by name ('Victoria') throughout the entire 10-minute interaction.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent completely failed Empathy throughout the call, ignoring two major customer distress moments regarding lost remote work pay at turn 1 and an ombudsman escalation outburst at turn 46 in the final third with cold procedural deflections.

grader.scenario: Persistent broadband drops over 3 weeks with repeated refused engineer callout charges
grader.notes: Short poor call (10:40) handled by Kieran. Customer suffered persistent broadband drops over 3 weeks with disputed callout fees. Agent accurately diagnosed optical drops and booked an engineer with a fee waiver, but failed 5 distinct criteria: Branding (opening omitted), Dead Air (two 30s+ gaps), Verified (skipped completely), Personalized (caller never named), and Empathy (two unhandled outbursts, including in the final third).
